file_type: ZIP archive containing a VBScript loader
malicious_evidence: URLhaus records retrieval of this exact ZIP on November 25. Triage binds the submitted archive to its extracted VBScript; the script writes into a dropped executable's memory, whose process installs Windows hooks and probes VirtualBox, VMware and system location.
legitimate_tool_review: Independent review confirms a malicious delivery archive from the combined script, memory-write, hook and evasion chain. The hash identifies the submitted ZIP; genuine Windows Script Host, OpenSSL libraries and PDF decoys are excluded.
limitations: URLhaus evidence was reviewed through public search-index text; direct access returned a browser check. Retrieval is day-only, distinct from URL addition and November 25 sandbox submission. Both Triage report pages were directly reviewed. Grandoreiro attribution comes from URLhaus, not an independent family match. Aggregate adware tags occur in separate PDF tasks; the reviewed VBS task has none. No network traffic was recorded in that task; theft, ransomware and current availability are unverified. First-ever observation is unknown.
